gap_addressed: backend/app/scoring/investment.py hardcodes Assumptions.interest_rate = 0.065 as a static default. A live national mortgage-rate series would let the investment model use the actual current rate instead of a stale constant, improving cash-flow and return projections for every property, in every market -- directly serves the 'generalizing to any US neighborhood' goal since it's a single national series with no per-metro plumbing needed.
recommendation_notes: High value for low integration cost: one national series, weekly cadence, feeds directly into an existing hardcoded assumption (investment.py's interest_rate default) rather than requiring new scoring logic. The catch is the ToS -- FRED's terms restrict commercial redistribution of raw series data. This project's use (reading one current value to set a default assumption, not republishing the historical series) is very likely fine under 'non-commercial/personal/educational' or ordinary application use, but a human should confirm that reading before implementing, since CLAUDE.md's licensing bar is 'no clause blocking commercial/product use' and FRED's clause is nuanced rather than a flat commercial ban. Requires a free API key, which is a new secret to manage (parallel to the existing RentCast key pattern in .env).
